task.title: Resolve Conflicts with AI
task.shortdesc: Let Positron analyze a conflict and propose a resolution you can review and apply.

step.cmd: Right-click the conflicting file and select .

stepresult.p:
Positron analyzes the conflicting file and its common ancestor, then opens the
window.

info.p:
The
pane explains, in plain language, what each side changed. Four comparison views let you inspect the proposal — Resolved vs Mine, Resolved vs Theirs, Resolved vs Conflicted, and Mine vs Theirs — where Mine is your version, Theirs is the incoming change, and Resolved is the AI proposal (always shown on the left). The resolved file is editable in each view, so you can fine-tune it; use Restore Original AI Suggestion to undo your edits.

result.p: The Git Client writes the resolution to your working copy and stages the file.
